shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at the origin on the left with the mark at (−3,0) on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The point belongs to the plotted graph and gives f(0)=0. Right image: The displayed function has no value at x=−3.
Rationales: On the left, the filled marker adds that coordinate pair to the graph and supplies the value at its horizontal coordinate. On the right, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=−3.
